house.description: Circle Pines; full-service deputy registrar's office established.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Transportation Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to motor vehicles; establishing full-service deputy registrar's office in the city of Circle Pines.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ADDITIONAL DEPUTY REGISTRAR OF MOTOR VEHICLES FOR ANOKA COUNTY. +]

[+Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 168.33, and rules adopted by the commissioner of public safety limiting sites for the office of deputy registrar based on either the distance to an existing deputy registrar office or the annual volume of transactions processed by any deputy registrar within Anoka County before or after the proposed appointment, the commissioner of public safety must appoint a new deputy registrar of motor vehicles and driver's license agent for Anoka County to operate a new full-service office of deputy registrar, with full authority to function as a registration and motor vehicle tax collection and driver's license bureau, at 9201 Lexington Avenue North in the city of Circle Pines. All other provisions regarding the appointment and operation of a deputy registrar of motor vehicles and driver's license agent under Minnesota Statutes, sections 168.33 and 171.061, and Minnesota Rules, chapter 7406, apply to the office. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to motor vehicles; establishing full-service deputy registrar's office in the city of Circle Pines.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ADDITIONAL DEPUTY REGISTRAR OF MOTOR VEHICLES FOR ANOKA COUNTY.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 168.33, and rules adopted by the commissioner of public safety limiting sites for the office of deputy registrar based on either the distance to an existing deputy registrar office or the annual volume of transactions processed by any deputy registrar within Anoka County before or after the proposed appointment, the commissioner of public safety must appoint a new deputy registrar of motor vehicles and driver's license agent for Anoka County to operate a new full-service office of deputy registrar, with full authority to function as a registration and motor vehicle tax collection and driver's license bureau, at 9201 Lexington Avenue North in the city of Circle Pines. All other provisions regarding the appointment and operation of a deputy registrar of motor vehicles and driver's license agent under Minnesota Statutes, sections 168.33 and 171.061, and Minnesota Rules, chapter 7406, apply to the office.
